dialogue.speaker: Sari
dialogue.text: Halo, selamat datang di hotel. Apakah Anda punya reservasi?
dialogue.en: Hello, welcome to the hotel. Do you have a reservation?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Ya, satu kamar untuk dua malam, atas nama saya.
dialogue.en: Yes, a room for two nights, under my name.

dialogue.speaker: Sari
dialogue.text: Ya, ini dia. Kamar single dengan pemandangan taman.
dialogue.en: Yes, here it is. A single room with a view of the garden.

dialogue.speaker: Sari
dialogue.text: Ya, sarapan termasuk, dari pukul tujuh sampai sepuluh. Ini kunci Anda.
dialogue.en: Yes, breakfast is included, from seven to ten. Here is your key.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Thank you. What is the room number?
